items.title: I was checking the rate calculation based on the rule, I added 2 rules based on the weight, I don’t think the rule was used for calculation, can you please chec
items.body:
• If the rate is defined in the dog profile then no rule applies and this is the rate used for calculation
  • if the rate is not defined for a dog then the default rate +/- (weight rule) applies
  • if the checkout is beyond the defined hours in the settings then surcharge is applied
  • Need additional surcharge rule in the settings to define the maximum hour until the 25-50% surcharge is applicable, if the pickup time exceed certain hours then a full day rate is applied (e.g. if the pickup time is 3 hours after 24 hr clock then surcharge is applied, but if the pickup time is > maximum of 8 hr after 24 hr clock then full day rate is applied)

comments.author: Developer
comments.body: Resolved - added a "Site Visit Tracking" section under Settings to pick which admin/staff accounts to exclude. A visit is attributed to a user once they sign in during that browsing session - even if they landed on the page before signing in - so excluding an account keeps their visits out of the dashboard numbers going forward.

items.title: Please verify calculation at checkout
items.body:
Looks like we need to verify the calculation, this issue is in continuation for #68

This booking started on 13 Aug at 8:30 am and ended on 15 Aug at 5:30, when I enter this time at checkout I  only see 2 nights, however based on the rule setup in the settings, where we set the additional hours between 2 and 8 hours which should convert into calculation as 
1. 13 Aug 8:30 am to 15 Aug 8:30 am = 2 full days (or 2 nights)
2. If the pickup was after 15 Aug 10:30 am until 4:30 pm = 2 days and late fee note with 50% late pickup charge
3. If the pickup is after 15 Aug 4:30 pm = 2 days + 1 full extra day charge



Two issues in the image above
1. It added 3rd day after the checkout time selected is after 8:30 pm
2. late pickup and full extra day both used the different rate (default rate from the settings) than the rate assigned to this dog

We check out another dog and the calculation worked for that dog, but didn't work for this dog
